figurative_meaning_en: To flatter someone in a subservient or obsequious manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: বসের পায়ে তেল দিয়ে সে প্রমোশন পেয়েছে।
রাজনীতিবিদরা নেতার পায়ে তেল দিয়ে সমর্থন আদায় করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He got the promotion by buttering up the boss.
Politicians gain support by fawning over the leader.
history: This idiom draws from traditional South Asian practices where applying oil to the feet of elders or superiors symbolizes deep respect and service, evolving into a metaphor for insincere flattery.
note: Common in colloquial Bengali, reflecting hierarchical social norms.
